scope: Progreso displayed beach profiles308..591 inclusive; manual rows only, not RGB red candidates
panel_formula: y=45+2*(150-offset_m); panels start x=44, profile centre x=83.5+80j
limitations: The 8m value is an operational interpretation tolerance, not physical certified accuracy.
Capture/date footprints must be checked separately; root owns those endpoint metadata checks.
Wave/foam and georeferencing/tidal physical uncertainty remain.
